product_metadata.title: 【2022 All New】 OriGlam Portable Electric Balloon Blower Pump, Dual Nozzle Balloon Air Inflator, 110V 680W with 2 Inflation Nozzles for Decoration
features: √ Powerful Air Pump - Inflating the balloons in a fast speed with two inflation ports.
√ Fit For Latex Decorative Balloon - Double pump, balloon air pump. Inflate balloons quickly under high pressure.
√ Time And Speed Controller - With the time controller and speed controller, can adjust the inflating time and the speed .
√ Touch-on Switch - Just put the small tips on the nozzle, then press the nozzle slightly, and it will inflate the balloon.
√ Light Weight And Portable Desigh - Easily creat a warm atomophere, commonly used in some activities/festive/party/celebration/decoration.
description: Power:800W Voltage: US: AC 110V ~ 120V Operating Temperature Range: 0 ~ 40℃. Color:Red  With the time controller and speed controller,can adjust the inflating time and the speed according to the balloon. Touch-on switch design, just put the small tips on the nozzle, then press the nozzle slightly, and it will inflate the balloon. Adjustable two tips for small balloon, when inflate the small size balloon, just put the tips on the inflation port.

1.Plug in the power supply. 2.3 Put a 10-inch latex ball around the air nozzle. 3.Put the switch in "I" gear. 4.Inflate the balloon with the pressure nozzle, release and stop the exhaust. 5. Twist the small air nozzle clockwise into the air nozzle. 6. Put a small latex ring ball on the air nozzle. 7. Press the air nozzle to inflate the balloon, release and stop the exhaust. 8.When gas is not used, turn the switch to gear 0.   Use steps if time and speed control are required:  1.Put the switch in the "II" file and the time display screen will light up. 2.Press the first time button, and the number on the right side of the screen will jump (milliseconds). 3.Press the second time button to adjust the time you want (0.1-9.9). 4.After you adjust the time you want, press the first time button to confirm. 5.If you think the wind speed is fast, you can turn the speed control button to the right and the wind speed will be slower. 6.After setting the time you want, Press the second power start button( green button).That is to start according to the set time inflatable.  Package Weight : 1685.0 G / 59.44 Ounces Package Dimensions (L*W*H) : 160*200*150 MM / 6.30*7.87*5.91 Inches
